 {id:'DS-N-API',sys:'sys1',code:'API',cat:'infra',status:'pending',name:'REST API',file:'(設計 · 後端第一階段)',desc:'專案 CRUD、啟動 Run、查報表、取風險矩陣、觸發回滾、Webhook。',fns:[{c:'EP',n:'/api/projects',d:'CRUD'},{c:'EP',n:'/api/runs',d:'啟動/查 Run'},{c:'EP',n:'/api/reports/{id}',d:'報表'},{c:'EP',n:'/api/.../risk-matrix',d:'風險矩陣'},{c:'EP',n:'/api/runs/{id}/rollback',d:'回滾'},{c:'EP',n:'/api/webhook',d:'外部事件'}],chips:['REST','設計']},
 {id:'DS-N-QUE',sys:'sys1',code:'QUE',cat:'infra',status:'pending',name:'Task Queue',file:'(設計)',desc:'並發任務緩衝/排程(RabbitMQ / Kafka / Redis)。',fns:[],chips:['RabbitMQ','設計']},

 {id:'DS-N-CICD',sys:'sys1',code:'CICD',cat:'infra',status:'pending',name:'CI/CD + 部署',file:'(設計)',desc:'Docker/K8s/Helm,RollingUpdate,roll-forward 為主、kubectl rollout undo 回滾。',fns:[],chips:['Docker','K8s','滾轉前推']},

/* ANIMATION LAB DATA */
const ANIMS={
 base:[['fade-in','淡入','fade-in .5s ease-out'],['fade-out','淡出','fade-out .5s ease-out forwards'],['slide-up','上滑','slide-up .5s ease-out'],['slide-down','下滑','slide-down .5s ease-out'],['zoom-in','放大','zoom-in .5s ease-out'],['pulse','脈衝','pulse .6s ease-in-out 2'],['bounce','彈跳','bounce .6s ease-out 2']],
 composite:[['fade-slide','淡入+上滑','fade-in .5s ease-out, slide-up .5s ease-out'],['zoom-fade','放大+淡入','zoom-in .5s ease-out, fade-in .5s ease-out'],['bounce-fade','彈跳+淡入','bounce .6s ease-out, fade-in .5s ease-out']],
 component:[['button-pulse','按鈕脈衝 (hover)','pulse .6s ease-in-out 2'],['menu-slide','選單下滑','slide-down .4s ease-out'],['chart-appear','圖表出現','zoom-in .5s ease-out'],['matrix-highlight','矩陣高亮','pulse 1s ease-out 2']]
};

/* ---- state ---- */
let activeCat='all', activeSys='all', layoutMode='auto', animOn=true, animSpeed=1;
const collapsed={};
let order=REG.map(r=>r.id);
const CAT_ORDER=['orchestrator','analysis','runner','lib','risk','integration','schema','engine','runtime','editor','qengine','decision','ai','tool','dashboard','gfx','grid','hci','motion','responsive','icon','aiassist','template','product','infra','pending'];
const STATUS_RANK={built:0,merged:1,pending:2};
const CAT_COLOR={orchestrator:'--bl',analysis:'--tl',runner:'--gn',lib:'--tl',risk:'--co',integration:'--ro',schema:'--i3',engine:'--bl',runtime:'--tl',editor:'--vi',qengine:'--gn',decision:'--bl',ai:'--vi',tool:'--am',dashboard:'--co',gfx:'--bl',grid:'--am',hci:'--vi',motion:'--ro',responsive:'--tl',icon:'--gn',aiassist:'--vi',template:'--co',product:'--ro',infra:'--i3',pending:'--am'};
const catRank=c=>{const i=CAT_ORDER.indexOf(c);return i<0?99:i;};
const statRank=s=>STATUS_RANK[s]!==undefined?STATUS_RANK[s]:1;

/* ---- stats ---- */
function buildStats(){
 const fns=REG.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.fns.length,0);
 const built=REG.filter(r=>r.status==='built').length;
 const pend=REG.filter(r=>r.status==='pending').length;
 const tools=REG.filter(r=>r.cat==='tool').length;
 const s=[{n:REG.length,l:'註冊項目',k:''},{n:REG.filter(r=>(r.sys||'sys2')==='sys1').length,l:'系統一 後端',k:'v'},{n:REG.filter(r=>(r.sys||'sys2')==='sys2').length,l:'系統二 前端',k:'t'},{n:fns,l:'函式/方法/枚舉',k:''},{n:built,l:'已建 BUILT',k:'g'},{n:pend,l:'待建 PENDING',k:'a'}];
 document.getElementById('stats').innerHTML=s.map(x=>`<div class="sc ${x.k}"><div class="n">${x.n}</div><div class="l">${x.l}</div></div>`).join('');
}

/* ---- filters ---- */
function buildFilters(){
 const c={};REG.forEach(r=>{if(activeSys!=='all'&&(r.sys||'sys2')!==activeSys)return;c[r.cat]=(c[r.cat]||0)+1;});
 const tot=REG.filter(r=>activeSys==='all'||(r.sys||'sys2')===activeSys).length;
 let h=`<div class="fb ${activeCat==='all'?'on':''}" onclick="setCat('all')">全部 <span class="ct">${tot}</span></div>`;
 Object.keys(CATS).forEach(k=>{if(!c[k])return;h+=`<div class="fb ${activeCat===k?'on':''}" onclick="setCat('${k}')">${CATS[k]} <span class="ct">${c[k]}</span></div>`;});
 document.getElementById('filters').innerHTML=h;
}
function sysOf(r){return r.sys||'sys2';}
function buildSysFilter(){
 const s1=REG.filter(r=>sysOf(r)==='sys1').length, s2=REG.filter(r=>sysOf(r)==='sys2').length;
 document.getElementById('sysbar').innerHTML=
  `<button class="sysb ${activeSys==='all'?'on':''}" onclick="setSys('all')">全部系統 <span class="ct">${REG.length}</span><small>後端治理引擎 + 前端指揮台</small></button>`+
  `<button class="sysb s1 ${activeSys==='sys1'?'on':''}" onclick="setSys('sys1')">🧠 系統一 · NexusCore Orchestrator <span class="ct">${s1}</span><small>後端治理引擎 · 三輪 · 九頭龍避險</small></button>`+
  `<button class="sysb s2 ${activeSys==='sys2'?'on':''}" onclick="setSys('sys2')">🖥 系統二 · Matrix Command Center <span class="ct">${s2}</span><small>前端指揮台 · UI/規格/視覺化</small></button>`;
}
function setSys(s){activeSys=s;activeCat='all';buildSysFilter();buildFilters();render();}
function buildFilters_unused(){
 const c={};REG.forEach(r=>c[r.cat]=(c[r.cat]||0)+1);
 let h=`<div class="fb ${activeCat==='all'?'on':''}" onclick="setCat('all')">全部 <span class="ct">${REG.length}</span></div>`;
 Object.keys(CATS).forEach(k=>{if(!c[k])return;h+=`<div class="fb ${activeCat===k?'on':''}" onclick="setCat('${k}')">${CATS[k]} <span class="ct">${c[k]}</span></div>`;});
 document.getElementById('filters').innerHTML=h;
}
function setCat(c){activeCat=c;buildFilters();render();}

/* ---- render ---- */
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');}
function render(){
 const q=(document.getElementById('search').value||'').toLowerCase().trim();
 const byId=Object.fromEntries(REG.map(r=>[r.id,r]));
 const rows=order.map(id=>byId[id]).filter(r=>{
  if(activeSys!=='all'&&(r.sys||'sys2')!==activeSys)return false;
  if(activeCat!=='all'&&r.cat!==activeCat)return false;
  if(!q)return true;
  const hay=(r.id+' '+r.code+' '+r.name+' '+r.desc+' '+r.chips.join(' ')+' '+r.fns.map(f=>f.n+' '+f.d).join(' ')).toLowerCase();
  return hay.includes(q);
 });
 const g=document.getElementById('grid');
 if(!rows.length){g.innerHTML=`<div class="empty">無符合「${esc(q)}」的項目</div>`;return;}
 const card=(r)=>{
  const open=collapsed[r.id]?'open':'';
  const drag=layoutMode==='manual'?'drag':'';
  const fnHtml=r.fns.length?`<div class="sub">函式 / 方法 / 枚舉 (${r.fns.length})</div>${r.fns.map(f=>`<div class="fn"><span class="fc">${f.c}</span><span><span class="fn-n">${esc(f.n)}</span> — <span class="fn-d">${esc(f.d)}</span></span></div>`).join('')}`:'';
  const chipHtml=r.chips.length?`<div class="chips">${r.chips.map(c=>`<span class="chip">${esc(c)}</span>`).join('')}</div>`:'';
  return `<div class="card cat-${r.cat} ${open} ${drag}" data-id="${r.id}" ${layoutMode==='manual'?'draggable="true"':''}>
    <div class="card-h" onclick="toggle('${r.id}')"><span class="grip">⠿</span><span class="code">${r.code}</span>
      <div class="tt"><div class="nm">${esc(r.name)}</div><div class="id">${r.id} · ${CATS[r.cat]}</div></div>
      <span class="bd ${r.status}">${r.status.toUpperCase()}</span><span class="ar">▶</span></div>
    <div class="card-b"><div class="ds">${esc(r.desc)}</div><span class="file">${esc(r.file)}</span>${chipHtml}${fnHtml}</div>
  </div>`;
 };
 /* 分類別分組 + 順序整理:auto 版面、未篩選、未搜尋時,依 CAT_ORDER 分組,組內 BUILT→PENDING;PENDING 類自動收於最後 */
 const grouped = layoutMode==='auto' && activeCat==='all' && !q;
 if(grouped){
  const cats=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.cat))].sort((a,b)=>catRank(a)-catRank(b));
  let html='';
  cats.forEach(cat=>{
   const grp=rows.filter(r=>r.cat===cat).sort((a,b)=>{
    const d=statRank(a.status)-statRank(b.status); if(d)return d;
    return order.indexOf(a.id)-order.indexOf(b.id);
   });
   const nb=grp.filter(r=>r.status==='built').length;
   const np=grp.filter(r=>r.status==='pending').length;
   html+=`<div class="grp-h" style="border-left-color:var(${CAT_COLOR[cat]||'--bl'})">`+
         `<span>${CATS[cat]||cat}</span><span class="gc">${grp.length}</span>`+
         (nb?`<span class="gb b">${nb} BUILT</span>`:'')+
         (np?`<span class="gb p">${np} PENDING</span>`:'')+
         `<span class="gl"></span></div>`;
   html+=grp.map(card).join('');
  });
  g.innerHTML=html;
 } else {
  g.innerHTML=rows.map(card).join('');
 }
 if(layoutMode==='manual')bindDrag();
}
function toggle(id){collapsed[id]=!collapsed[id];render();}
function expandAll(v){REG.forEach(r=>collapsed[r.id]=v);render();}
function clearSearch(){document.getElementById('search').value='';render();}

/* ---- manual drag reorder ---- */
let dragId=null;
function bindDrag(){
 document.querySelectorAll('.card[draggable="true"]').forEach(card=>{
  card.addEventListener('dragstart',e=>{dragId=card.dataset.id;card.classList.add('dragging');e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move';});
  card.addEventListener('dragend',()=>{card.classList.remove('dragging');document.querySelectorAll('.dropbefore').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('dropbefore'));});
  card.addEventListener('dragover',e=>{e.preventDefault();document.querySelectorAll('.dropbefore').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('dropbefore'));card.classList.add('dropbefore');});
  card.addEventListener('drop',e=>{e.preventDefault();const tgt=card.dataset.id;if(!dragId||dragId===tgt)return;
    order=order.filter(x=>x!==dragId);order.splice(order.indexOf(tgt),0,dragId);dragId=null;render();});
 });
}
function autoArrange(){order=REG.map(r=>r.id);setLayoutMode('auto',document.querySelector('#segLayout button'));render();}

/* ---- control bar ---- */
function toggleCtrl(){document.getElementById('ctrl').classList.toggle('on');}
function segOn(seg,btn){seg.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('on'));btn.classList.add('on');}
function setLayoutMode(m,btn){layoutMode=m;segOn(document.getElementById('segLayout'),btn);render();}
function setCols(v){v=+v;const g=document.getElementById('grid');
 if(v===0){document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--cols','auto');g.classList.add('auto');document.getElementById('colVal').textContent='Auto';}
 else{g.classList.remove('auto');document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--cols',`repeat(${v},1fr)`);document.getElementById('colVal').textContent=v;}}
function setGap(v){document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--gap',v+'px');document.getElementById('gapVal').textContent=v+'px';}
function setFont(v){document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ui',v);}
function setAnim(on,btn){animOn=on;segOn(document.getElementById('segAnim'),btn);document.body.classList.toggle('no-anim',!on);}
function setSpeed(v){animSpeed=+v;document.getElementById('spdVal').textContent=(+v).toFixed(1)+'×';}
function setTheme(t,btn){document.body.classList.toggle('dark',t==='dark');segOn(document.getElementById('segTheme'),btn);
 document.getElementById('themeBtn').textContent=t==='dark'?'☀ Light':'🌙 Dark';try{localStorage.setItem('ds_theme',t)}catch(e){}}
function toggleTheme(){const d=!document.body.classList.contains('dark');const seg=document.getElementById('segTheme');
 setTheme(d?'dark':'light',seg.children[d?1:0]);}
function setResp(px,label,btn){document.getElementById('stage').style.maxWidth=px+'px';segOn(document.getElementById('segResp'),btn);
 document.getElementById('respVal').textContent=label+' · '+px+'px';}
function resetAll(){
 layoutMode='auto';order=REG.map(r=>r.id);activeCat='all';animOn=true;animSpeed=1;
 document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--cols','auto');document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--gap','8px');
 document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ui','var(--sa)');document.body.classList.remove('no-anim','dark');
 document.getElementById('stage').style.maxWidth='1500px';document.getElementById('fontSel').value='var(--sa)';
 document.getElementById('colRange').value=0;document.getElementById('colVal').textContent='Auto';
 document.getElementById('gapRange').value=8;document.getElementById('gapVal').textContent='8px';
 document.getElementById('spdRange').value=1;document.getElementById('spdVal').textContent='1.0×';
 document.getElementById('respVal').textContent='Desktop · 1500px';
 ['segLayout','segAnim','segTheme','segResp'].forEach(s=>{const seg=document.getElementById(s);segOn(seg,seg.children[0]);});
 document.getElementById('themeBtn').textContent='🌙 Dark';document.getElementById('grid').classList.add('auto');
 buildFilters();render();
}

/* ---- tabs ---- */
function swPg(btn,id){document.querySelectorAll('.pt button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('on'));btn.classList.add('on');
 document.querySelectorAll('.pg').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('on'));document.getElementById(id).classList.add('on');
 if(id==='pg2')buildLab();if(id==='pg4')buildWizard();if(id==='pg5')buildLocked();if(id==='pg6')initRenderer();if(id==='pg7')buildArch();if(id==='pg8')buildAssets();if(id==='pg9')buildProd();if(id==='pg10')buildTpl();}

/* ---- animation lab ---- */
function buildLab(){
 const m=document.getElementById('labMount');
 const tile=(key,nm,ty,anim)=>`<div class="lab"><div class="demo"><div class="box" data-anim="${anim}"></div></div><div class="nm">${key}</div><div class="ty">${nm} · ${ty}</div><button class="bn sm play" onclick="playAnim(this)">▶ 播放</button></div>`;
 m.innerHTML=
  `<div class="lab-grp">Base · 7 基礎 keyframes</div><div class="lab-grid">${ANIMS.base.map(a=>tile(a[0],a[1],'base',a[2])).join('')}</div>`+
  `<div class="lab-grp">Composite · 3 組合動畫</div><div class="lab-grid">${ANIMS.composite.map(a=>tile(a[0],a[1],'composite',a[2])).join('')}</div>`+
  `<div class="lab-grp">Component · 4 元件動畫</div><div class="lab-grid">${ANIMS.component.map(a=>tile(a[0],a[1],'component',a[2])).join('')}</div>`;
}
function playAnim(btn){
 if(!animOn){btn.textContent='⏸ 動畫已關';setTimeout(()=>btn.textContent='▶ 播放',900);return;}
 const box=btn.closest('.lab').querySelector('.box');
 let anim=box.dataset.anim;
 if(animSpeed!==1){anim=anim.replace(/(\d*\.?\d+)s/g,(m,n)=>(parseFloat(n)/animSpeed).toFixed(2)+'s');}
 box.style.animation='none';void box.offsetWidth;box.style.animation=anim;
}

/* ---- export ---- */
function exportJSON(){
 const out={system:'VIA Decision Studio — Function & Tool Registry',version:'1.1',
  principle:'append-only (只增不減) · zero-omission (避免遺漏)',generated:new Date().toISOString(),
  counts:{items:REG.length,functions:REG.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.fns.length,0),built:REG.filter(r=>r.status==='built').length,pending:REG.filter(r=>r.status==='pending').length},
  animations:ANIMS,order,registry:REG};
 const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(out,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});
 const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='DecisionStudio_Registry.json';a.click();
}

/* ============ v1.2 · HTML READER (讀取HTML → 建立規格) ============ */
let lastSpec=null;
function buildReader(){
 const dz=document.getElementById('dz'),fi=document.getElementById('fileInput');
 ['dragover','dragenter'].forEach(ev=>dz.addEventListener(ev,e=>{e.preventDefault();dz.classList.add('over');}));
 ['dragleave'].forEach(ev=>dz.addEventListener(ev,e=>{e.preventDefault();dz.classList.remove('over');}));
 dz.addEventListener('drop',e=>{e.preventDefault();dz.classList.remove('over');const f=e.dataTransfer.files[0];if(f)readFile(f);});
 fi.addEventListener('change',e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(f)readFile(f);});
}
function confirmTarget(){
 const v=document.getElementById('targetInput').value.trim()||'(未指定)';
 const s=document.getElementById('targetStatus');s.textContent='目標已鎖定: '+v;s.style.color='var(--gn)';
}
function readFile(f){
 document.getElementById('targetInput').value=f.name;confirmTarget();
 const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>parseHTML(r.result,f.name);r.readAsText(f);
}
function parseHTML(html,name){
 const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,'text/html');
 const styles=[...doc.querySelectorAll('style')].map(s=>s.textContent).join('\n');
 const tokens={};
 (styles.match(/:root\s*\{([^}]*)\}/g)||[]).join(';').replace(/--([\w-]+)\s*:\s*([^;]+)/g,(m,k,v)=>{tokens['--'+k]=v.trim();});
 const imports=styles.match(/@import[^;]+;/g)||[];
 const fonts=[...new Set((styles.match(/font-family\s*:\s*[^;}]+/g)||[]).map(s=>s.replace(/font-family\s*:\s*/,'').trim()))].slice(0,8);
 const keyframes=[...new Set((styles.match(/@keyframes\s+([\w-]+)/g)||[]).map(s=>s.replace(/@keyframes\s+/,'')))];
 const animations=[...new Set((styles.match(/animation\s*:\s*[^;}]+/g)||[]).map(s=>s.replace(/animation\s*:\s*/,'').trim()))];
 const media=[...new Set((styles.match(/@media[^{]+/g)||[]).map(s=>s.trim()))];
 const tables=[...doc.querySelectorAll('table')].map(t=>({id:t.id||'',cols:[...t.querySelectorAll('th')].map(th=>th.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean)}));
 const cs=doc.querySelector('meta[charset]'),vp=doc.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]');
 const spec={file:name,title:(doc.title||'').trim(),lang:doc.documentElement.getAttribute('lang')||'',
  charset:cs?cs.getAttribute('charset'):'',viewport:vp?vp.getAttribute('content'):'',
  tokens,imports,fonts,keyframes,animations,media,
  components:{tables,forms:doc.querySelectorAll('form').length,inputs:doc.querySelectorAll('input,textarea').length,buttons:doc.querySelectorAll('button').length,selects:doc.querySelectorAll('select').length},
  structure:{ids:doc.querySelectorAll('[id]').length,scripts:doc.querySelectorAll('script').length,styleBlocks:doc.querySelectorAll('style').length,elements:doc.querySelectorAll('*').length}};
 lastSpec=spec;renderExtracted(spec);
}
function renderExtracted(s){
 const tokRows=Object.entries(s.tokens).map(([k,v])=>{const col=/^#|rgb|hsl/i.test(v);
  return `<div class="tokrow"><span class="sw" style="background:${col?esc(v):'transparent'};${col?'':'border-style:dashed'}"></span><span style="min-width:96px">${esc(k)}</span><span style="color:var(--i2)">${esc(v)}</span></div>`;}).join('')||'<div class="xrow"><span class="v">— 無 :root tokens —</span></div>';
 const tblRows=s.components.tables.map((t,i)=>`<div class="xrow"><span class="k">table #${esc(t.id||('idx'+i))}</span><span class="v">${t.cols.length?esc(t.cols.join(' · ')):'(無 th)'}</span></div>`).join('');
 document.getElementById('xmount').innerHTML=
  `<div class="xsec"><h4>檔案 / Meta</h4>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">file</span><span class="v">${esc(s.file)}</span></div>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">title</span><span class="v">${esc(s.title)||'—'}</span></div>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">lang / charset</span><span class="v">${esc(s.lang)||'—'} / ${esc(s.charset)||'—'}</span></div>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">viewport</span><span class="v">${esc(s.viewport)||'—'}</span></div></div>
   <div class="xsec"><h4>設計 Tokens (:root · ${Object.keys(s.tokens).length})</h4>${tokRows}</div>
   <div class="xsec"><h4>字體 / Fonts</h4>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">@import</span><span class="v">${s.imports.length?esc(s.imports.join('  ')):'—'}</span></div>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">font-family</span><span class="v">${s.fonts.length?esc(s.fonts.join('  |  ')):'—'}</span></div></div>
   <div class="xsec"><h4>動畫 / Animation</h4>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">@keyframes (${s.keyframes.length})</span><span class="v">${s.keyframes.length?esc(s.keyframes.join(' · ')):'—'}</span></div>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">animation 宣告</span><span class="v">${s.animations.length?esc(s.animations.slice(0,10).join(' · ')):'—'}</span></div></div>
   <div class="xsec"><h4>響應式 / @media (${s.media.length})</h4><div class="xrow"><span class="v">${s.media.length?esc(s.media.join('   ·   ')):'—'}</span></div></div>
   <div class="xsec"><h4>元件 / Components</h4>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">tables / forms</span><span class="v">${s.components.tables.length} / ${s.components.forms}</span></div>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">inputs / selects / buttons</span><span class="v">${s.components.inputs} / ${s.components.selects} / ${s.components.buttons}</span></div>${tblRows}</div>
   <div class="xsec"><h4>結構 / Structure</h4>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">IDs / scripts / styles</span><span class="v">${s.structure.ids} / ${s.structure.scripts} / ${s.structure.styleBlocks}</span></div>
    <div class="xrow"><span class="k">total elements</span><span class="v">${s.structure.elements}</span></div></div>
   <button class="bn bp" onclick="exportExtracted()" style="margin-top:4px">⬇ 匯出抽取規格 JSON</button>
   <button class="bn" onclick="addExtractedToRegistry()" style="margin-top:4px">➕ 登錄為規格 (補充至註冊表)</button>`;
}
function addExtractedToRegistry(){
 if(!lastSpec)return;
 const n=REG.filter(r=>r.id.startsWith('DS-X-')).length+1;
 const id='DS-X-'+String(n).padStart(2,'0');
 REG.push({id,code:'EXT',cat:'tool',status:'built',name:'抽取規格 · '+lastSpec.file,file:lastSpec.file,
  desc:`由 HTML Reader 抽取登錄(append-only):${Object.keys(lastSpec.tokens).length} tokens · ${lastSpec.keyframes.length} keyframes · ${lastSpec.media.length} media · ${lastSpec.components.tables.length} tables。`,
  fns:[{c:'TOK',n:Object.keys(lastSpec.tokens).length+' design tokens',d:lastSpec.fonts.join(', ')||'—'},
       {c:'ANI',n:lastSpec.keyframes.join(', ')||'(無 keyframes)',d:'動畫'},
       {c:'CMP',n:`tables ${lastSpec.components.tables.length} · forms ${lastSpec.components.forms} · btn ${lastSpec.components.buttons}`,d:'元件'},
       {c:'STR',n:`IDs ${lastSpec.structure.ids} · elements ${lastSpec.structure.elements}`,d:'結構'}],
  chips:['抽取','append-only',lastSpec.title||'untitled']});
 order.push(id);buildStats();buildFilters();
 const s=document.getElementById('targetStatus');s.textContent='已登錄為 '+id+'(切到「功能註冊表」查看)';s.style.color='var(--gn)';
}
function exportExtracted(){if(lastSpec)dl(JSON.stringify(lastSpec,null,2),'extracted_spec.json');}
function dl(text,name){const b=new Blob([text],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(b);a.download=name;a.click();}

/* ============ v1.2 · REQUIREMENTS QUESTIONNAIRE (問券化 → 建立規格新模板) ============ */
const WIZQ=[
 {id:'kind',q:'1. 你要做哪一種介面?',h:'決定整體骨架',type:'single',opts:['儀表板 Dashboard','表單/問卷','報表 Report','落地頁 Landing']},
 {id:'layout',q:'2. 版面怎麼排?',h:'→ layout.type / columns',type:'single',opts:['自動網格 auto','雙欄','單欄','固定 N 欄']},
 {id:'theme',q:'3. 主題色調?',h:'→ theme.mode',type:'single',opts:['Light 淺色','Dark 深色','跟隨系統']},
 {id:'comps',q:'4. 要哪些元件?(可複選)',h:'→ components[]',type:'multi',opts:['按鈕','圖表','風險矩陣','問卷','選單','表格']},
 {id:'anim',q:'5. 動畫風格?',h:'→ theme.animation',type:'single',opts:['fade-slide','pulse','zoom','無動畫']},
 {id:'resp',q:'6. 需要響應式嗎?',h:'手機/平板自適應',type:'single',opts:['要','不用']},
 {id:'lock',q:'7. 哪些規格要鎖死?(可複選)',h:'→ locked:true 不可變更',type:'multi',opts:['配色三色','字體比率','Logo 規範','Header 三行']}
];
const wizAns={};
function buildWizard(){
 document.getElementById('wizMount').innerHTML=
  WIZQ.map(Q=>`<div class="wz"><div class="q">${Q.q}</div><div class="h">${Q.h}</div><div class="opts">${Q.opts.map(o=>`<span class="opt ${isSel(Q,o)?'on':''}" onclick="pick('${Q.id}','${o}','${Q.type}',this)">${o}</span>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')
  +`<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin:4px 0 10px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="bn bp" onclick="genSpec()">✓ 產生規格模板</button><button class="bn" onclick="exportWizSpec()">⬇ 匯出模板 JSON</button><button class="bn" onclick="resetWiz()" style="color:var(--co)">✕ 清除</button></div>`
  +`<div id="wizOut" class="wzout">回答上面問題 → 按「產生規格模板」即可得到可用的 UI-Spec JSON 新模板。</div>`;
}
function isSel(Q,o){const a=wizAns[Q.id];return Q.type==='multi'?(a||[]).includes(o):a===o;}
function pick(id,o,type,el){
 if(type==='multi'){wizAns[id]=wizAns[id]||[];const i=wizAns[id].indexOf(o);if(i>=0){wizAns[id].splice(i,1);el.classList.remove('on');}else{wizAns[id].push(o);el.classList.add('on');}}
 else{wizAns[id]=o;el.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.opt').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));el.classList.add('on');}
}
function resetWiz(){for(const k in wizAns)delete wizAns[k];window._wizSpec=null;buildWizard();}
function genSpec(){
 const cM={'按鈕':'button','圖表':'chart','風險矩陣':'matrix','問卷':'questionnaire','選單':'menu','表格':'table'};
 const lM={'自動網格 auto':{type:'grid',columns:'auto',auto_optimize:true},'雙欄':{type:'grid',columns:2,auto_optimize:false},'單欄':{type:'grid',columns:1,auto_optimize:false},'固定 N 欄':{type:'grid',columns:4,auto_optimize:false}};
 const aM={'fade-slide':'fade-slide','pulse':'pulse','zoom':'zoom-in','無動畫':'none'};
 const kM={'配色三色':'theme.colors','字體比率':'theme.fontRatio','Logo 規範':'logo','Header 三行':'header'};
 const t=wizAns.theme||'Light 淺色';
 const spec={_template:'VIA Decision Studio · UI-Spec (questionnaire-generated)',
  kind:wizAns.kind||'儀表板 Dashboard',layout:lM[wizAns.layout]||lM['自動網格 auto'],
  theme:{mode:t.startsWith('Dark')?'dark':t.includes('系統')?'system':'light',primary:'#4c78a8',secondary:'#9c9890',accent:'#439a9a',animation:aM[wizAns.anim]||'fade-slide'},
  responsive:(wizAns.resp||'要')==='要',
  components:(wizAns.comps||['按鈕']).map((c,i)=>({type:cM[c]||'button',id:(cM[c]||'comp')+'-'+(i+1),locked:false})),
  locked:(wizAns.lock||[]).map(l=>kM[l]).filter(Boolean)};
 window._wizSpec=spec;document.getElementById('wizOut').textContent=JSON.stringify(spec,null,2);
}
function exportWizSpec(){if(window._wizSpec)dl(JSON.stringify(window._wizSpec,null,2),'ui-spec-template.json');else{genSpec();if(window._wizSpec)dl(JSON.stringify(window._wizSpec,null,2),'ui-spec-template.json');}}

/* ============ v1.2 · LOCKED SPEC (鎖死規範) ============ */
const LOCKED=[
 ['配色 · Veritas 主色','#4c78a8','三色鎖定'],['配色 · Decision 次色','#9c9890','三色鎖定'],['配色 · Studio 強調','#439a9a','三色鎖定'],
 ['字體比率','base 11px · ratio 100%','鎖死'],['字體族','DM Sans / DM Mono / Syne','鎖定'],
 ['Logo · 背景','透明去背 · 無底色/無框/無特效','鎖死'],['Logo · 縮放','自動高清 · favicon 16–256 多尺寸最大化','鎖死'],['Logo · 內嵌','base64 一勞永逸','鎖死'],
 ['Header','三行結構 · 第一行三色去空格堆疊','鎖死'],['圓角 / 陰影','--r 5/8/12px · --sh / --sh2','鎖定'],
 ['註冊原則','只增不減 Append-Only · 避免遺漏 Zero-Omission','鎖死']
];
function buildLocked(){
 const extra=((window._wizSpec&&window._wizSpec.locked)||[]).map(x=>[x,'(問卷選定)','LOCKED']);
 document.getElementById('lockMount').innerHTML=
  LOCKED.concat(extra).map(r=>`<div class="lk"><span class="lkk">${esc(r[0])}</span><span class="lkv">${esc(r[1])}</span><span class="lkb">🔒 ${esc(r[2])}</span></div>`).join('')
  +`<button class="bn bp" onclick="exportLocked()" style="margin-top:8px">⬇ 匯出鎖死規範 JSON</button>`;
}
function exportLocked(){
 dl(JSON.stringify({system:'VIA Decision Studio · Locked Specification (鎖死規範)',principle:'immutable · append-only',generated:new Date().toISOString(),locked:LOCKED.map(r=>({key:r[0],value:r[1],status:r[2]}))},null,2),'locked-spec.json');
}

/* ============ v1.3 · LIVE RENDERER (F) + SURVEY ANALYZER (H) ============ */
const SAMPLE_SPEC={_template:'sample',kind:'儀表板 Dashboard',
 layout:{type:'grid',columns:'auto',auto_optimize:true},
 theme:{mode:'light',primary:'#4c78a8',secondary:'#9c9890',accent:'#439a9a',animation:'fade-slide'},
 responsive:true,
 components:[{type:'button',id:'btn-1'},{type:'chart',id:'chart-1'},{type:'matrix',id:'matrix-1'},{type:'questionnaire',id:'q-1'},{type:'menu',id:'menu-1'},{type:'table',id:'table-1'}]};
let curSpec=null;
function initRenderer(){if(!curSpec)renderUISpec(window._wizSpec||SAMPLE_SPEC);}
function loadSampleSpec(){renderUISpec(SAMPLE_SPEC);}
function applyWizSpecToRender(){
 if(!window._wizSpec){document.getElementById('renderStatus').textContent='尚未產生問卷規格 → 先到「需求問卷」按產生';return;}
 renderUISpec(window._wizSpec);
}
function renderSpecJSON(){
 document.getElementById('renderJSON').innerHTML=curSpec?`<div class="rout">${esc(JSON.stringify(curSpec,null,2))}</div>`:'';
}
function applySpecTheme(theme){
 const st=document.getElementById('renderStage');
 if(theme&&theme.animation&&theme.animation!=='none'&&!document.body.classList.contains('no-anim')){
  [...st.children].forEach((c,i)=>{c.style.animation='none';void c.offsetWidth;
   const a=theme.animation==='pulse'?'pulse .6s ease-in-out 2':theme.animation==='zoom-in'||theme.animation==='zoom'?'zoom-in .45s ease-out':'fade-in .45s ease-out, slide-up .45s ease-out';
   c.style.animationDelay=(i*0.06)+'s';c.style.animation=a;});
 }
}
function rcard(title,inner){return `<div class="rc"><div class="rc-t">${title}</div>${inner}</div>`;}
function renderUISpec(spec){
 curSpec=spec;const st=document.getElementById('renderStage');
 const comps=(spec.components||[]);let html='';
 comps.forEach(c=>{
  if(c.type==='button')html+=rcard('button · '+(c.id||''),rRenderButton(c));
  else if(c.type==='chart')html+=rcard('chart · '+(c.id||''),rRenderChart(c));
  else if(c.type==='matrix')html+=rcard('matrix · '+(c.id||''),'<div id="mx-'+c.id+'"></div>');
  else if(c.type==='questionnaire')html+=rcard('questionnaire · '+(c.id||''),rRenderQuestionnaire(c));
  else if(c.type==='menu')html+=rcard('menu · '+(c.id||''),rRenderMenu(c));
  else if(c.type==='table')html+=rcard('table · '+(c.id||''),rRenderTable(c));
 });
 st.innerHTML=html||'<div class="empty">此規格沒有可渲染元件</div>';
 comps.filter(c=>c.type==='matrix').forEach(c=>rRenderMatrix(c));
 document.getElementById('renderStatus').textContent='已渲染 '+comps.length+' 個元件 · 主題 '+((spec.theme||{}).mode||'light');
 document.getElementById('renderJSON').innerHTML='';
 applySpecTheme(spec.theme);
}
/* component renderers */
function rRenderButton(c){return `<button class="rbtn" onclick="this.textContent='已點擊 ✓';this.style.background='var(--gn)'">送出 Submit</button>`;}
function rRenderChart(c){
 const data=[{l:'Q1',v:62},{l:'Q2',v:88},{l:'Q3',v:45},{l:'Q4',v:73},{l:'Q5',v:96}];
 const mx=Math.max(...data.map(d=>d.v));
 return `<div class="rchart">${data.map(d=>`<div class="rbar" style="height:${Math.round(d.v/mx*88)}%"><span>${d.v}</span><small>${d.l}</small></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
}
let mxData={}, mxSort={};
function rRenderMatrix(c){
 mxData[c.id]=[{dim:'跨模組風險',score:3},{dim:'資料一致性',score:2},{dim:'效能',score:1},{dim:'可維護性',score:2},{dim:'安全',score:3}];
 mxSort[c.id]=null;drawMatrix(c.id);
}
function classifyRisk(s){return s>=3?'high':s>=2?'medium':'low';}
function sortMatrixDemo(id,key){
 mxSort[id]=mxSort[id]===key?null:key;
 if(key)mxData[id].sort((a,b)=>key==='score'?b.score-a.score:String(a.dim).localeCompare(b.dim));
 drawMatrix(id);
}
function drawMatrix(id){
 const lvlTxt={high:'高 HIGH',medium:'中 MED',low:'低 LOW'};
 const rows=mxData[id].map(r=>{const l=classifyRisk(r.score);return `<tr><td style="text-align:left">${esc(r.dim)}</td><td>${r.score}</td><td class="lvl-${l}">${lvlTxt[l]}</td></tr>`;}).join('');
 document.getElementById('mx-'+id).innerHTML=`<table class="rmx"><tr><th onclick="sortMatrixDemo('${id}','dim')">維度 ▲</th><th onclick="sortMatrixDemo('${id}','score')">分數 ▼</th><th>等級</th></tr>${rows}</table>`;
}
const RQDEF=[{id:'rq1',q:'風險程度?',type:'radio',opts:['高','中','低']},{id:'rq2',q:'關注項目?(複選)',type:'checkbox',opts:['效能','風險','一致性']},{id:'rq3',q:'穩定度評分',type:'rating',max:5},{id:'rq4',q:'觀察補充',type:'text'},{id:'rq5',q:'信心(0–100)',type:'slider'}];
function rRenderQuestionnaire(c){
 let h='';RQDEF.forEach(q=>{
  h+=`<div class="rq"><div class="rq-q">${q.q}</div>`;
  if(q.type==='radio')h+=q.opts.map(o=>`<label><input type="radio" name="${c.id}-${q.id}" value="${o}">${o}</label>`).join('');
  else if(q.type==='checkbox')h+=q.opts.map(o=>`<label><input type="checkbox" name="${c.id}-${q.id}" value="${o}">${o}</label>`).join('');
  else if(q.type==='rating')h+=`<span data-rate="${c.id}-${q.id}">${Array.from({length:q.max},(_,i)=>`<span class="rstar" onclick="setStar(this,${i+1})">★</span>`).join('')}</span>`;
  else if(q.type==='text')h+=`<textarea name="${c.id}-${q.id}" rows="2" placeholder="輸入..."></textarea>`;
  else if(q.type==='slider')h+=`<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" name="${c.id}-${q.id}">`;
  h+='</div>';
 });
 h+=`<div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><button class="bn bp sm" onclick="collectRQ('${c.id}')">收集答案</button><button class="bn sm" onclick="analyzeRQ('${c.id}')">分析 H</button></div><div id="rqout-${c.id}"></div>`;
 return h;
}
function setStar(el,n){const wrap=el.parentElement;[...wrap.children].forEach((s,i)=>s.classList.toggle('on',i<n));wrap.dataset.val=n;}
function collectRQ(cid){
 const data={};RQDEF.forEach(q=>{const nm=cid+'-'+q.id;
  if(q.type==='radio')data[q.id]=(document.querySelector(`input[name="${nm}"]:checked`)||{}).value||null;
  else if(q.type==='checkbox')data[q.id]=[...document.querySelectorAll(`input[name="${nm}"]:checked`)].map(i=>i.value);
  else if(q.type==='rating'){const r=document.querySelector('[data-rate="'+nm+'"]');data[q.id]=r?(+r.dataset.val||0):0;}
  else if(q.type==='text')data[q.id]=(document.querySelector(`textarea[name="${nm}"]`)||{}).value||'';
  else if(q.type==='slider')data[q.id]=+(document.querySelector(`input[name="${nm}"]`)||{}).value||0;
 });
 document.getElementById('rqout-'+cid).innerHTML=`<div class="rout">${esc(JSON.stringify(data,null,2))}</div>`;
 return data;
}
function weightScore(d){let s=0;if(d.rq1==='高')s+=3;else if(d.rq1==='中')s+=2;else if(d.rq1==='低')s+=1;
 s+=(d.rq2||[]).length;s+=Math.round((+d.rq3||0));s+=Math.round((+d.rq5||0)/25);return s;}
function analyzeSurvey(d){const score=weightScore(d);const lvl=classifyRisk(score>=8?3:score>=5?2:1);
 return {score,level:lvl,answered:Object.values(d).filter(v=>v&&(!Array.isArray(v)||v.length)).length};}
function analyzeRQ(cid){
 const d=collectRQ(cid);const a=analyzeSurvey(d);
 const lvlTxt={high:'高風險 HIGH',medium:'中風險 MEDIUM',low:'低風險 LOW'};
 document.getElementById('rqout-'+cid).innerHTML+=`<div class="ranalyze">分析 (H · Survey Analyzer):加權分數 <b>${a.score}</b> · 等級 <b>${lvlTxt[a.level]}</b> · 已答 ${a.answered}/5 題</div>`;
}
function rRenderMenu(c){return `<ul class="rmenu"><li>Dashboard</li><li>Reports</li><li>Settings</li><li>About</li></ul>`;}
function rRenderTable(c){
 const rows=[['VDF','DataForge','A'],['VRN','ReportNova','A'],['VPN','PanoramaNexus','B'],['VGF','GlyphForge','A']];
 return `<table class="rtbl"><tr><th>UID</th><th>Name</th><th>Grade</th></tr>${rows.map(r=>`<tr><td>${r[0]}</td><td>${r[1]}</td><td>${r[2]}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>`;
}

/* ============ v1.4 · SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE (兩大系統資料流) ============ */
function buildArch(){
 const sys1=REG.filter(r=>(r.sys||'sys2')==='sys1');
 const sys2=REG.filter(r=>(r.sys||'sys2')==='sys2');
 const pills=arr=>arr.slice(0,16).map(r=>`<span class="arch-pill ${r.cat==='risk'?'hi':''}">${esc(r.code)} · ${esc(r.name.split(' (')[0])}</span>`).join('');
 document.getElementById('archMount').innerHTML=`<div class="arch">
  <div class="arch-box io"><div class="arch-h" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--am)">① 專案來源 Inputs</div>
    <div class="arch-pills"><span class="arch-pill">Python</span><span class="arch-pill">JavaScript / HTML</span><span class="arch-pill">Node.js</span><span class="arch-pill">PowerShell</span><span class="arch-pill">C# / .NET</span></div></div>
  <div class="arch-arrow">▼</div>
  <div class="arch-box s1"><div class="arch-h s1">② 系統一 · VIA NexusCore Orchestrator</div>
    <div class="arch-sub">後端治理引擎 · 跨語言自動 Test→Debug→Optimize→Consolidate · 嚴格九頭龍避險 · 加速器全開</div>
    <div class="arch-round">
      <div class="arch-r r0"><b>Round 0 全景分析</b>只分析不修;Layer-0 多源交叉 + Dragon-9 風險 + 分類平行/順序</div>
      <div class="arch-r r1"><b>Round 1 平行修正</b>互不影響項並行修 + 多源驗證</div>
      <div class="arch-r r2"><b>Round 2 順序修正</b>依賴鏈 schema→repo→service→api→ui</div>
      <div class="arch-r r3"><b>Round 3 收尾</b>清理 / 整合 / 最終測試</div>
    </div>
    <div class="arch-pills" style="margin-top:7px">${pills(sys1)}</div></div>
  <div class="arch-arrow">▼</div>
  <div class="arch-box io"><div class="arch-h" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--am)">③ 產出 Outputs</div>
    <div class="arch-pills"><span class="arch-pill">matrix_round0–3.json</span><span class="arch-pill hi">Dragon-9 Risk Matrix</span><span class="arch-pill">Round Reports</span></div></div>
  <div class="arch-arrow">▼</div>
  <div class="arch-box s2"><div class="arch-h s2">④ 系統二 · VIA Matrix Command Center</div>
    <div class="arch-sub">前端指揮台 · 讀 Matrix JSON → 風險色/Tooltip/Round 切換 · 規格讀取/建立/補充 · 選單化/問券化/視覺化 · 動畫 + CSS Grid 自動排版</div>
    <div class="arch-pills">${pills(sys2)}</div></div>
  <div class="arch-arrow">▼</div>
  <div class="arch-box actor"><div class="arch-h" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--bl)">⑤ Tony · 視覺化決策</div>
    <div class="arch-sub" style="margin-bottom:0">檢查 → 比較(Round 0/1/2/3)→ 確認 → 規劃下一步</div></div>
 </div>`;
}

/* ============ v1.5 · DESIGN ASSETS (列管 + 取用 + AI 選用) ============ */
function toast(msg){let el=document.getElementById('toast');if(!el){el=document.createElement('div');el.id='toast';el.className='toast';document.body.appendChild(el);}el.textContent=msg;el.classList.add('on');clearTimeout(window._tt);window._tt=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('on'),1500);}
function copyText(t){try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(t);toast('已複製 ✓');}catch(e){const ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=t;document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();try{document.execCommand('copy');toast('已複製 ✓');}catch(_){toast('複製失敗,請手動選取');}ta.remove();}}
function replayFx(el,cls){el.classList.remove(cls);void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add(cls);}

const ASSET_CSS={
 'fx-lift':'.fx-lift{transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s}\n.fx-lift:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}',
 'fx-press':'.fx-press{transition:transform .1s}\n.fx-press:active{transform:scale(.9)}',
 'fx-ring':'.fx-ring{transition:.15s}\n.fx-ring:hover,.fx-ring:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(76,120,168,.35)}',
 'fx-shake':'.fx-shake:hover{animation:shake .4s}\n@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%,60%{transform:translateX(-5px)}40%,80%{transform:translateX(5px)}}',
 'fx-spin':'.fx-spin{animation:spin 1s linear infinite}\n@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}',
 'fx-shimmer':'.fx-shimmer{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#eee 25%,#ddd 50%,#eee 75%);background-size:200% 100%;animation:shimmer 1.3s infinite}\n@keyframes shimmer{to{background-position:-200% 0}}',
 'fx-grad':'.fx-grad{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#4c78a8,#7a6daa,#439a9a,#4c78a8);background-size:300% 300%;animation:grad 4s ease infinite}\n@keyframes grad{0%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}100%{background-position:0% 50%}}',
 'fx-glass':'.fx-glass{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3)}',
 'fx-spring':'.fx-spring{animation:spring .55s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}\n@keyframes spring{from{transform:scale(.5);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}',
 'fx-float':'.fx-float{animation:float 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}\n@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}',
 'fx-morph':'.fx-morph{animation:morph 5s ease-in-out infinite}\n@keyframes morph{0%,100%{border-radius:38% 62% 63% 37%/41% 44% 56% 59%}50%{border-radius:62% 38% 37% 63%/56% 59% 41% 44%}}',
 'g-autofit':'display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:12px',
 'g-12':'display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:8px',
 'g-sidebar':'display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px 1fr;gap:12px',
 'g-holy':"display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;grid-template-areas:'side head' 'side main';gap:8px",
 'g-split':'display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px',
 'g-masonry':'columns:3;column-gap:12px',
 'r-fluid':'font-size:clamp(0.9rem, 0.6rem + 1.5vw, 1.4rem);',
 'r-stack':'@media (max-width:768px){\n  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}\n}',
 'r-hide':'@media (max-width:480px){\n  .desktop-only{display:none}\n}',
 'r-container':'.card-wrap{container-type:inline-size}\n@container (min-width:400px){\n  .card{display:flex}\n}'
};
function copyAsset(k){copyText(ASSET_CSS[k]||'');}

const HCI=[['fx-lift','懸停浮起','hover'],['fx-press','按下縮放','active'],['fx-ring','focus 光環','focus'],['fx-shake','錯誤抖動','error'],['fx-spin','載入轉圈','loading'],['__toast','通知 Toast','feedback']];
const MOT=[['fx-shimmer','骨架微光','skeleton'],['fx-grad','漸層流動','gradient'],['fx-glass','玻璃擬態','glass'],['fx-spring','彈簧彈出','spring'],['fx-float','漂浮','float'],['fx-morph','有機形變','blob']];
const GRIDS=[['g-autofit','auto-fit 卡片',6],['g-12','12 欄儀表板',12],['g-sidebar','側欄 240+1fr',2],['g-holy','Holy Grail',4],['g-split','split 1fr 1fr',2],['g-masonry','masonry 欄',6]];
const RWD=[['r-fluid','流體字級 clamp'],['r-stack','手機堆疊'],['r-hide','隱藏/顯示'],['r-container','容器查詢 @container']];

 ['home','<path d="M3 11l9-8 9 8"/><path d="M5 10v10h14V10"/>'],['search','<circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><line x1="16.5" y1="16.5" x2="21" y2="21"/>'],
 ['settings','<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3M5 5l2 2M17 17l2 2M19 5l-2 2M7 17l-2 2"/>'],

 ['chart','<line x1="4" y1="20" x2="20" y2="20"/><rect x="6" y="11" width="3" height="9"/><rect x="11" y="6" width="3" height="14"/><rect x="16" y="13" width="3" height="7"/>'],
 ['grid','<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="3" y1="9" x2="21" y2="9"/><line x1="3" y1="15" x2="21" y2="15"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/>'],
 ['menu','<line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"/><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"/>'],

 ['check','<polyline points="4 12 10 18 20 6"/>'],['plus','<line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/>'],
 ['edit','<path d="M4 20h4L20 8l-4-4L4 16v4z"/>'],['trash','<path d="M4 7h16"/><path d="M6 7l1 13h10l1-13"/><path d="M9 7V4h6v3"/>'],
 ['download','<path d="M12 3v12"/><polyline points="7 11 12 16 17 11"/><line x1="4" y1="20" x2="20" y2="20"/>'],
 ['upload','<path d="M12 16V4"/><polyline points="7 9 12 4 17 9"/><line x1="4" y1="20" x2="20" y2="20"/>'],
 ['filter','<polygon points="3 4 21 4 14 12 14 19 10 21 10 12"/>'],['lock','<rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="9" rx="2"/><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4"/>'],
 ['bell','<path d="M6 16V11a6 6 0 0 1 12 0v5l2 2H4z"/><path d="M10 21h4"/>'],
 ['star','<polygon points="12 3 15 9 21 10 16.5 14.5 18 21 12 17.5 6 21 7.5 14.5 3 10 9 9"/>'],
 ['refresh','<path d="M20 11a8 8 0 1 0-2 5"/><polyline points="20 4 20 10 14 10"/>'],
 ['folder','<path d="M3 7h6l2 2h10v10H3z"/>'],['info','<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><line x1="12" y1="11" x2="12" y2="16"/><circle cx="12" cy="8" r=".6" fill="currentColor"/>'],

function svgOf(inner){return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${inner}</svg>`;}
function copyIcon(i){copyText(svgOf(ICONS[i][1]));}

const AISEL={
 '儀表板 Dashboard':{anim:'scroll-reveal + count-up',grid:'12 欄儀表板 / auto-fit 卡片',chart:'heatmap + bar',icon:'chart · grid · filter'},
 '表單 / 問卷':{anim:'focus 光環 + 彈簧彈出',grid:'單欄 / 側欄',chart:'progress',icon:'check · edit · user'},
 '警示 / 風險':{anim:'抖動 + pulse',grid:'auto-fit 卡片',chart:'gauge + radar',icon:'warning · bell · lock'},
 '載入中 Loading':{anim:'骨架微光 + 轉圈',grid:'auto-fit 卡片',chart:'—',icon:'refresh'},
 '導覽 / 選單':{anim:'懸停浮起 + 選單下滑',grid:'側欄 240+1fr',chart:'—',icon:'menu · home · settings'},
 '數據比較':{anim:'count-up',grid:'split 1fr 1fr',chart:'bar + line + radar',icon:'chart · sort'},
 '行動裝置 Mobile':{anim:'上滑 slide-up',grid:'手機堆疊',chart:'sparkline',icon:'menu · close'}
};
let aiPick=null;

function buildAssets(){
 const tile=(cls,nm,ty)=>cls==='__toast'
   ? `<div class="asset"><div class="ademo"><button class="rbtn" onclick="toast('範例通知 ✓')">通知</button></div><div class="anm">toast</div><div class="aty">${ty}</div><button class="bn sm copy" onclick="copyText('呼叫 toast(msg):滑入 → 1.5s 後淡出')">📋 用法</button></div>`
   : `<div class="asset"><div class="ademo"><div class="dbox ${cls}" onclick="replayFx(this,'${cls}')">▦</div></div><div class="anm">${cls.replace('fx-','')}</div><div class="aty">${nm} · ${ty}</div><button class="bn sm copy" onclick="copyAsset('${cls}')">📋 複製 CSS</button></div>`;
 const gridTile=(k,nm,n)=>{const tmpl=ASSET_CSS[k].includes('grid-template-columns')?ASSET_CSS[k].match(/grid-template-columns:([^;]+)/)[1]:(k==='g-masonry'?'repeat(3,1fr)':'1fr 1fr');
   const cells=Array.from({length:n},()=>'<i></i>').join('');
   return `<div class="asset"><div class="ademo"><div class="gridprev" style="grid-template-columns:${tmpl}">${cells}</div></div><div class="anm">${nm}</div><button class="bn sm copy" onclick="copyAsset('${k}')">📋 複製 CSS</button></div>`;};
 const rwdTile=(k,nm)=>`<div class="asset" style="text-align:left"><div class="anm" style="margin-bottom:4px">${nm}</div><div class="rout" style="max-height:80px;font-size:8px">${esc(ASSET_CSS[k])}</div><button class="bn sm copy" onclick="copyAsset('${k}')" style="margin-top:5px">📋 複製</button></div>`;
 // charts (self-contained demos)
 const bars=[60,90,45,75,100].map(v=>`<div style="flex:1;height:${v}%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bl),var(--tl));border-radius:2px 2px 0 0"></div>`).join('');
 const heat=Array.from({length:16},(_,i)=>{const c=[['var(--gn-l)','var(--am-l)','var(--co-l)'][i%3]];return `<div style="background:${c};border-radius:2px"></div>`;}).join('');
 const spark='<svg viewBox="0 0 100 32" style="width:100%;height:40px"><polyline points="0,24 15,18 30,22 45,8 60,14 75,4 100,12" fill="none" stroke="var(--bl)" stroke-width="2"/></svg>';
 const radar='<svg viewBox="0 0 60 60" style="width:50px;height:50px"><polygon points="30,4 52,22 44,52 16,52 8,22" fill="none" stroke="var(--bd)"/><polygon points="30,14 44,26 38,44 22,44 18,26" fill="rgba(76,120,168,.35)" stroke="var(--bl)"/></svg>';
 const gauge='<div style="width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(var(--co) 0 70%, var(--bg2) 70% 100%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center"><div style="width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sf);font-size:9px;font-family:var(--mo);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center">70</div></div>';
 const donut='<div style="width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(var(--bl) 0 45%,var(--tl) 45% 70%,var(--am) 70% 100%)"></div>';
 const gfxTile=(demo,nm,lib)=>`<div class="asset"><div class="ademo">${demo}</div><div class="anm">${nm}</div><div class="aty">${lib}</div><button class="bn sm copy" onclick="copyText('推薦庫: ${lib}')">📋 用法</button></div>`;
 const icons=ICONS.map(([n,inner],i)=>`<div class="iconcell" title="複製 SVG: ${n}" onclick="copyIcon(${i})"><span class="ico">${svgOf(inner)}</span><span class="icn">${n}</span></div>`).join('');

 document.getElementById('assetMount').innerHTML=
  `<div class="lab-grp">人機互動動畫 (HCI · 6) — 點方塊重播 / 滑過看效果</div><div class="asset-grid">${HCI.map(a=>tile(a[0],a[1],a[2])).join('')}</div>`+
  `<div class="lab-grp">現代化動畫 (Motion · 6)</div><div class="asset-grid">${MOT.map(a=>tile(a[0],a[1],a[2])).join('')}</div>`+
  `<div class="lab-grp">CSS Grid 版型 (6)</div><div class="asset-grid">${GRIDS.map(g=>gridTile(g[0],g[1],g[2])).join('')}</div>`+
  `<div class="lab-grp">Matrix Dashboard 圖表 / 圖形 (7)</div><div class="asset-grid">`+
   gfxTile(`<div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:44px;width:80px">${bars}</div>`,'bar 長條','Chart.js / ECharts')+
   gfxTile(spark,'sparkline 折線','Recharts / D3')+
   gfxTile(`<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,9px);grid-auto-rows:9px;gap:2px">${heat}</div>`,'heatmap 熱力圖','本工具內建 / D3')+
   gfxTile(radar,'radar 雷達','ECharts / Chart.js')+
   gfxTile(gauge,'gauge 儀表','ECharts')+
   gfxTile(donut,'donut 圓環','conic-gradient / Chart.js')+
   gfxTile(`<div style="width:80px"><div style="height:8px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden"><div style="width:68%;height:100%;background:var(--bl)"></div></div></div>`,'progress 進度','純 CSS')+
  `</div>`+
  `<div class="lab-grp">響應式設計 (Responsive · 5)</div><div class="asset-grid">`+
   `<div class="asset" style="text-align:left"><div class="anm" style="margin-bottom:4px">斷點 Breakpoints</div><div class="rout" style="max-height:90px;font-size:8px">sm  : 480px\nmd  : 768px\nlg  : 1024px\nxl  : 1280px\n2xl : 1536px</div><button class="bn sm copy" onclick="copyText('--bp-sm:480px; --bp-md:768px; --bp-lg:1024px; --bp-xl:1280px; --bp-2xl:1536px;')" style="margin-top:5px">📋 複製 tokens</button></div>`+
   RWD.map(r=>rwdTile(r[0],r[1])).join('')+
  `</div>`+
  `<div class="lab-grp">Icon Base 圖示庫 — 點圖示複製 SVG · 內建 ${ICONS.length}</div>`+
  `<div class="dz" id="iconDz" style="padding:14px;margin-bottom:8px"><input type="file" id="iconFiles" accept="image/*,.svg" multiple><span class="ic">🖼️</span><div class="dzlb">載入我的 Icon Base(拖放 / 選檔 · 可多選)</div><div class="dzsub">支援 SVG/PNG/ICO · 對應本機 …\\VeritasIntelligenceAnalytics\\icon base · 點縮圖複製檔名</div></div>`+
  `<div class="icongrid" id="myIcons"></div>`+
  `<div class="icongrid" style="margin-top:6px">${icons}</div>`+
  `<div class="lab-grp">AI 選用建議 (AI-Powered Selection) — 選用途 → 推薦動畫+Grid+圖表+圖示</div>`+
  `<div class="ai-chips" id="aiChips">${Object.keys(AISEL).map(k=>`<span class="ai-chip ${aiPick===k?'on':''}" onclick="aiRecommend('${k}')">${k}</span>`).join('')}</div>`+
  `<div id="aiRec"></div>`;
 bindIconLoader();
 if(aiPick)aiRecommend(aiPick);
}
function aiRecommend(intent){
 aiPick=intent;
 document.querySelectorAll('#aiChips .ai-chip').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('on',c.textContent===intent));
 const r=AISEL[intent];
 document.getElementById('aiRec').innerHTML=`<div class="ai-rec"><b>🤖 針對「${esc(intent)}」的建議組合</b>
   <div class="row"><span class="k">動畫</span><span>${esc(r.anim)}</span></div>
   <div class="row"><span class="k">CSS Grid</span><span>${esc(r.grid)}</span></div>
   <div class="row"><span class="k">圖表</span><span>${esc(r.chart)}</span></div>
   <div class="row"><span class="k">圖示</span><span>${esc(r.icon)}</span></div>
   <div style="font-size:8.5px;color:var(--i3);margin-top:6px">離線啟發式建議;可接 Decision AI(模組 O · callAI)升級為真 AI 生成完整 UI-Spec。</div></div>`;
}
function bindIconLoader(){
 const dz=document.getElementById('iconDz'),fi=document.getElementById('iconFiles');if(!dz)return;
 ['dragover','dragenter'].forEach(ev=>dz.addEventListener(ev,e=>{e.preventDefault();dz.classList.add('over');}));
 dz.addEventListener('dragleave',e=>{e.preventDefault();dz.classList.remove('over');});
 dz.addEventListener('drop',e=>{e.preventDefault();dz.classList.remove('over');addIcons(e.dataTransfer.files);});
 fi.addEventListener('change',e=>addIcons(e.target.files));
}
function addIcons(files){
 const m=document.getElementById('myIcons');
 [...files].forEach(f=>{
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(f);
  const cell=document.createElement('div');cell.className='iconcell';cell.title='複製檔名: '+f.name;
  cell.onclick=()=>copyText(f.name);
  cell.innerHTML=`<img src="${url}" alt="${esc(f.name)}"><span class="icn">${esc(f.name.length>14?f.name.slice(0,12)+'…':f.name)}</span>`;
  m.appendChild(cell);
 });
 if(files.length)toast('已載入 '+files.length+' 個圖示');
}

/* ============ v1.6 · PRODUCT / MACHINE REGISTRATION + FEEDBACK ============ */
const LS={get:(k,d)=>{try{const v=localStorage.getItem(k);return v==null?d:JSON.parse(v);}catch(e){return d;}},set:(k,v)=>{try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v));}catch(e){}}};
let PRD=LS.get('ds_prd',[]), MCH=LS.get('ds_mch',[]), FB=LS.get('ds_fb',[]);
let prdView='list', fbSort={key:'ts',dir:-1}, fbFilter='all', cmpNo=null;
function persist(){LS.set('ds_prd',PRD);LS.set('ds_mch',MCH);LS.set('ds_fb',FB);}
function seedMachines(){if(MCH.length)return;MCH=[{id:'M01',name:'機台一'},{id:'M02',name:'機台二'}];persist();}
function nextPrdNo(){let mx=0;PRD.forEach(p=>{const m=/VIA-PRD-(\d+)/.exec(p.no);if(m)mx=Math.max(mx,+m[1]);});return 'VIA-PRD-'+String(mx+1).padStart(3,'0');}
function sigOf(mods){return mods.map(id=>{const r=REG.find(x=>x.id===id);return r?r.code:id;}).join('+');}
let prdQ='';
function renderModPick(){
 const q=prdQ.trim().toLowerCase();
 const list=REG.filter(r=>!q||(r.name+r.id+r.code).toLowerCase().includes(q));
 return list.map(r=>`<label><input type="checkbox" class="mp" value="${r.id}"><span class="mc">${esc(r.code)}</span> ${esc(r.name)} <span style="color:var(--i4);font-size:8px">${esc(r.id)}</span></label>`).join('')||'<div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--i3);padding:6px">查無模組</div>';
}
function buildProd(){
 seedMachines();
 document.getElementById('prdMount').innerHTML=
  `<div class="prd-wrap">
    <div class="prd-panel"><h4>① 新增組合產品(多組合產品編號)</h4>
      <input id="prdName" placeholder="產品名稱(例:風險治理主控組)" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:6px">
      <input id="prdSearch" placeholder="🔍 篩選模組…" oninput="prdQ=this.value;document.getElementById('prdModList').innerHTML=renderModPick()" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:5px">
      <div class="modpick" id="prdModList">${renderModPick()}</div>
      <button class="bn" style="margin-top:7px;width:100%" onclick="addProduct()">＋ 建立產品編號(自動 VIA-PRD-NNN)</button>
    </div>
    <div class="prd-panel"><h4>② 機台註冊</h4>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:6px"><input id="mchId" placeholder="代號 M03" style="width:90px"><input id="mchName" placeholder="機台名稱" style="flex:1"></div>
      <button class="bn sm" onclick="addMachine()">＋ 新增機台</button>
      <div id="mchList" style="margin-top:8px">${renderMchList()}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="lab-grp">③ 管理視圖</div>
  <div class="seg">
    <button class="${prdView==='list'?'on':''}" onclick="setPrdView('list')">📋 產品清單</button>
    <button class="${prdView==='matrix'?'on':''}" onclick="setPrdView('matrix')">🔲 反饋矩陣</button>
    <button class="${prdView==='compare'?'on':''}" onclick="setPrdView('compare')">⚖ 機台對比</button>
  </div>
  <div id="prdView">${renderView()}</div>`;
}
function renderMchList(){return MCH.length?MCH.map(m=>`<span class="mch-tag">${esc(m.id)} · ${esc(m.name)}</span>`).join(' '):'<span style="font-size:9px;color:var(--i3)">尚無機台</span>';}
function addMachine(){
 const id=(document.getElementById('mchId').value||'').trim(), nm=(document.getElementById('mchName').value||'').trim();
 if(!id){toast('請填機台代號');return;}
 if(MCH.some(m=>m.id===id)){toast('機台代號已存在');return;}
 MCH.push({id,name:nm||id});persist();buildProd();toast('已新增機台 '+id);
}
function addProduct(){
 const name=(document.getElementById('prdName').value||'').trim();
 const mods=[...document.querySelectorAll('#prdModList .mp:checked')].map(c=>c.value);
 if(!name){toast('請填產品名稱');return;}
 if(!mods.length){toast('請至少勾選一個模組');return;}
 const no=nextPrdNo();
 PRD.push({no,name,modules:mods,sig:sigOf(mods),ver:'1.0.0',machines:[],status:'active',created:Date.now()});
 persist();prdQ='';buildProd();toast('已建立 '+no);
}
function assignMachine(no,mid,on){
 const p=PRD.find(x=>x.no===no);if(!p)return;
 if(on){if(!p.machines.includes(mid))p.machines.push(mid);}
 else p.machines=p.machines.filter(m=>m!==mid);
 persist();
 FB.push({id:'fb'+Date.now(),no,machine:mid,type:on?'upd':'upd',note:(on?'註冊到機台 ':'解除機台 ')+mid,status:'done',ver:p.ver,ts:Date.now()});
 persist();renderProdInto();
}
function bumpVersion(no){
 const p=PRD.find(x=>x.no===no);if(!p)return;
 const seg=p.ver.split('.').map(Number);seg[2]=(seg[2]||0)+1;p.ver=seg.join('.');
 FB.push({id:'fb'+Date.now(),no,machine:'',type:'ver',note:'版本更新 → v'+p.ver,status:'done',ver:p.ver,ts:Date.now()});
 persist();renderProdInto();toast(no+' → v'+p.ver);
}
function toggleProdStatus(no){const p=PRD.find(x=>x.no===no);if(!p)return;p.status=p.status==='active'?'retired':'active';persist();renderProdInto();}
function addFeedback(no){
 const ty=document.getElementById('fbty-'+no).value, mid=document.getElementById('fbmc-'+no).value, note=(document.getElementById('fbnt-'+no).value||'').trim(), st=document.getElementById('fbst-'+no).value;
 if(!note){toast('請填反饋內容');return;}
 const p=PRD.find(x=>x.no===no);
 FB.push({id:'fb'+Date.now(),no,machine:mid,type:ty,note,status:st,ver:p?p.ver:'',ts:Date.now()});
 persist();renderProdInto();toast('已記錄');
}
function toggleFb(id){const f=FB.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!f)return;f.status=f.status==='open'?'done':'open';persist();renderProdInto();}
function fmtTs(t){const d=new Date(t);const p=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth()+1)}-${p(d.getDate())} ${p(d.getHours())}:${p(d.getMinutes())}`;}
function renderProdInto(){const el=document.getElementById('prdView');if(el)el.innerHTML=renderView();}
function setPrdView(v){prdView=v;const bs=document.querySelectorAll('#prdMount .seg button');['list','matrix','compare'].forEach((k,i)=>{if(bs[i])bs[i].classList.toggle('on',k===v);});document.getElementById('prdView').innerHTML=renderView();}
function renderView(){return prdView==='matrix'?renderFbMatrix():prdView==='compare'?renderCompare():renderProdList();}
const TYLAB={fb:'反饋',upd:'更新',bug:'Bug',ver:'版本'};
function renderFbMatrix(){
 if(!FB.length)return '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--i3);padding:8px">尚無反饋/更新記錄。先到產品清單記錄。</div>';
 let rows=FB.slice();
 if(fbFilter==='open')rows=rows.filter(f=>f.status==='open');
 const k=fbSort.key,dir=fbSort.dir;
 rows.sort((a,b)=>{let x=k==='ts'?a.ts:(a[k]==null?'':a[k]),y=k==='ts'?b.ts:(b[k]==null?'':b[k]);x=x.toString();y=y.toString();return x<y?-dir:x>y?dir:0;});
 const arrow=key=>fbSort.key===key?(fbSort.dir<0?' ▼':' ▲'):'';
 const head=[['no','產品'],['machine','機台'],['type','類型'],['note','內容'],['status','狀態'],['ver','版本'],['ts','時間']].map(([key,l])=>`<th onclick="sortFb('${key}')">${l}${arrow(key)}</th>`).join('');
 const body=rows.map(f=>`<tr class="t-${f.type}"><td style="font-family:var(--mo);font-size:8.5px">${esc(f.no)}</td><td>${esc(f.machine||'—')}</td><td><b>${TYLAB[f.type]||f.type}</b></td><td>${esc(f.note)}</td><td><span class="stt ${f.status}" style="cursor:pointer" title="點擊切換" onclick="toggleFb('${f.id}')">${f.status==='open'?'待辦':'完成'}</span></td><td style="font-family:var(--mo);font-size:8.5px">${f.ver?'v'+esc(f.ver):'—'}</td><td style="font-family:var(--mo);font-size:8px;white-space:nowrap">${fmtTs(f.ts)}</td></tr>`).join('');
 const open=FB.filter(f=>f.status==='open').length;
 return `<div style="margin-bottom:6px;font-size:9px;color:var(--i2)">共 ${FB.length} 筆 · 待辦 ${open} ·
   <span class="ai-chip ${fbFilter==='all'?'on':''}" style="padding:2px 9px" onclick="setFbFilter('all')">全部</span>
   <span class="ai-chip ${fbFilter==='open'?'on':''}" style="padding:2px 9px" onclick="setFbFilter('open')">只看待辦</span>
   <span style="color:var(--i3)">· 點欄位排序</span>
   <button class="bn sm" style="margin-left:6px" onclick="exportFbCsv()">⬇ CSV</button></div>
   ${fbMiniStats()}
   <div style="overflow:auto"><table class="fbm"><thead><tr>${head}</tr></thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
function sortFb(k){if(fbSort.key===k)fbSort.dir*=-1;else{fbSort.key=k;fbSort.dir=1;}document.getElementById('prdView').innerHTML=renderFbMatrix();}
function setFbFilter(v){fbFilter=v;document.getElementById('prdView').innerHTML=renderFbMatrix();}
function renderCompare(){
 if(!PRD.length)return '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--i3);padding:8px">尚無產品。</div>';
 if(!cmpNo||!PRD.some(p=>p.no===cmpNo)){const d=PRD.find(p=>p.machines.length>=2)||PRD[0];cmpNo=d.no;}
 const p=PRD.find(x=>x.no===cmpNo);
 const sel=`<select onchange="setCmp(this.value)" style="padding:5px 8px;font-size:10px;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:6px;background:var(--sf);margin-bottom:8px">${PRD.map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x.no)}" ${x.no===cmpNo?'selected':''}>${esc(x.no)} · ${esc(x.name)}${x.machines.length>=2?' (對'+x.machines.length+'機)':''}</option>`).join('')}</select>`;
 let cols=p.machines.slice();
 if(FB.some(f=>f.no===p.no&&!f.machine))cols.push('');
 if(!cols.length)return sel+'<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--i3);padding:8px">此產品尚未註冊機台。請到「產品清單」勾選機台(一號對多機)。</div>';
 const colHtml=cols.map(mid=>{
   const m=MCH.find(x=>x.id===mid);
   const fbs=FB.filter(f=>f.no===p.no&&(f.machine||'')===mid).sort((a,b)=>b.ts-a.ts);
   const open=fbs.filter(f=>f.status==='open').length, done=fbs.filter(f=>f.status==='done').length;
   const verFb=fbs.find(f=>f.ver); const lastVer=verFb?verFb.ver:p.ver;
   const last=fbs.length?fmtTs(fbs[0].ts):'—';
   const mini=fbs.slice(0,6).map(f=>`<div class="m">[${TYLAB[f.type]||f.type}] ${esc(f.note)}${f.status==='open'?' · <i style="color:var(--am)">待辦</i>':''}</div>`).join('')||'<div class="m" style="color:var(--i3)">無記錄</div>';
   return `<div class="cmp-col"><h5>${mid?esc(mid)+(m?' · '+esc(m.name):''):'未指定機台'}</h5>
     <div class="cmp-stat"><span>反饋總數</span><b>${fbs.length}</b></div>
     <div class="cmp-stat"><span>待辦 / 完成</span><span><b style="color:var(--am)">${open}</b> / <b style="color:var(--gn)">${done}</b></span></div>
     <div class="cmp-stat"><span>最新版本</span><b>v${esc(lastVer)}</b></div>
     <div class="cmp-stat"><span>最後活動</span><b style="font-size:8.5px">${last}</b></div>
     <div class="cmp-mini">${mini}</div></div>`;
 }).join('');
 return sel+`<div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--i2);margin-bottom:6px"><b style="font-family:var(--mo);color:var(--ro)">${esc(p.no)}</b> · ${esc(p.name)} · 一號對 ${p.machines.length} 機 · 組合 [${esc(p.sig)}] · v${esc(p.ver)}</div><div class="cmp" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(${cols.length},minmax(0,1fr))">${colHtml}</div>`;
}
function setCmp(no){cmpNo=no;document.getElementById('prdView').innerHTML=renderCompare();}
function renderProdList(){
 if(!PRD.length)return '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--i3);padding:8px">尚無產品。在上方勾選模組後建立第一個產品編號。</div>';
 const tyLab={fb:'反饋',upd:'更新',bug:'Bug',ver:'版本'};
 return PRD.map(p=>{
  const mchChks=MCH.map(m=>`<span class="mch-chk ${p.machines.includes(m.id)?'on':''}" onclick="assignMachine('${p.no}','${m.id}',${!p.machines.includes(m.id)})">${p.machines.includes(m.id)?'✓ ':''}${esc(m.id)}</span>`).join('');
  const mods=p.modules.map(id=>{const r=REG.find(x=>x.id===id);return `<span>${esc(r?r.code:id)}</span>`;}).join('');
  const logs=FB.filter(f=>f.no===p.no).sort((a,b)=>b.ts-a.ts).map(f=>`<div class="fb-row"><span class="ty ${f.type}">${tyLab[f.type]||f.type}</span><span class="st ${f.status}" onclick="toggleFb('${f.id}')" style="cursor:pointer" title="點擊切換狀態">${f.status==='open'?'待辦':'完成'}</span><span>${esc(f.note)}${f.machine?` <i style="color:var(--i3)">@${esc(f.machine)}</i>`:''}</span><span class="ts">${fmtTs(f.ts)}${f.ver?' · v'+esc(f.ver):''}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div style="font-size:8.5px;color:var(--i3);padding:3px">尚無記錄</div>';
  return `<div class="prd-card ${p.status==='retired'?'off':''}">
    <div><span class="prd-no">${esc(p.no)}</span> <b style="font-size:11px">${esc(p.name)}</b> <span class="prd-sig">[${esc(p.sig)}]</span>
      <span style="float:right;display:flex;gap:5px"><span class="mch-tag">v${esc(p.ver)}</span>
      <button class="bn sm" onclick="bumpVersion('${p.no}')">版本+</button>
      <button class="bn sm" onclick="toggleProdStatus('${p.no}')">${p.status==='active'?'停用':'啟用'}</button></span></div>
    <div class="prd-mods">${mods}</div>
    <div class="mch-line"><span style="font-family:var(--mo);font-size:8.5px;color:var(--i3)">註冊機台(${p.machines.length}):</span>${mchChks||'<span style="font-size:9px;color:var(--i3)">先新增機台</span>'}</div>
    <div class="fb-add">
      <select id="fbty-${p.no}"><option value="fb">反饋</option><option value="upd">更新</option><option value="bug">Bug</option><option value="ver">版本</option></select>
      <select id="fbmc-${p.no}"><option value="">(不指定機台)</option>${MCH.map(m=>`<option value="${esc(m.id)}">${esc(m.id)}</option>`).join('')}</select>
      <input class="note" id="fbnt-${p.no}" placeholder="反饋/更新內容…">
      <select id="fbst-${p.no}"><option value="open">待辦</option><option value="done">完成</option></select>
      <button class="bn sm" onclick="addFeedback('${p.no}')">＋ 記錄</button>
    </div>
    <div class="fb-log">${logs}</div>
  </div>`;
 }).join('');
}
function exportReg(){
 const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify({products:PRD,machines:MCH,feedback:FB,exported:new Date().toISOString()},null,2)],{type:'application/json'});
 const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='VIA_ProductRegistry.json';a.click();toast('已匯出');
}
function importReg(file){
 const fr=new FileReader();fr.onload=()=>{try{const d=JSON.parse(fr.result);
   if(Array.isArray(d.products))PRD=d.products;if(Array.isArray(d.machines))MCH=d.machines;if(Array.isArray(d.feedback))FB=d.feedback;
   persist();buildProd();toast('已匯入 '+PRD.length+' 產品');}catch(e){toast('匯入失敗:JSON 格式錯誤');}};
 fr.readAsText(file);
}
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target&&e.target.id==='regImp'&&e.target.files[0])importReg(e.target.files[0]);});

/* ---- v1.8 feedback grouping stats + CSV ---- */
function fbMiniStats(){
 if(!FB.length)return '';
 const TYC={fb:'var(--gn)',upd:'var(--bl)',bug:'var(--co)',ver:'var(--vi)'},TYL={fb:'反饋',upd:'更新',bug:'Bug',ver:'版本'};
 const byType={},byMch={};FB.forEach(f=>{byType[f.type]=(byType[f.type]||0)+1;const m=f.machine||'(產品)';byMch[m]=(byMch[m]||0)+1;});
 const mxT=Math.max(1,...Object.values(byType)),mxM=Math.max(1,...Object.values(byMch));
 const open=FB.filter(f=>f.status==='open').length,done=FB.length-open;
 const bar=(label,n,mx,color)=>`<div class="fbbar"><span class="bn2">${label}</span><span class="tr2"><span class="fl2" style="width:${Math.round(n/mx*100)}%;background:${color}"></span></span><span class="v2">${n}</span></div>`;
 const tBars=['bug','upd','fb','ver'].filter(t=>byType[t]).map(t=>bar(TYL[t],byType[t],mxT,TYC[t])).join('');
 const mBars=Object.entries(byMch).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,6).map(([m,n])=>bar(m,n,mxM,'var(--tl)')).join('');
 const sBars=bar('待辦',open,Math.max(1,open,done),'var(--am)')+bar('完成',done,Math.max(1,open,done),'var(--gn)');
 return `<div class="fbstats"><div class="grp"><div class="gl">依類型</div>${tBars}</div><div class="grp"><div class="gl">依機台</div>${mBars}</div><div class="grp"><div class="gl">依狀態</div>${sBars}</div></div>`;
}
function exportFbCsv(){
 if(!FB.length){toast('尚無反饋可匯出');return;}
 const TYL={fb:'反饋',upd:'更新',bug:'Bug',ver:'版本'};
 const q=s=>'"'+String(s==null?'':s).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';
 const head=['產品編號','機台','類型','內容','狀態','版本','時間'];
 const lines=[head.join(',')].concat(FB.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.ts-a.ts).map(f=>[f.no,f.machine||'',TYL[f.type]||f.type,f.note,f.status==='open'?'待辦':'完成',f.ver||'',fmtTs(f.ts)].map(q).join(',')));
 const blob=new Blob(['\ufeff'+lines.join('\r\n')],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
 const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='VIA_Feedback.csv';a.click();toast('已匯出 CSV');
}

];

const NORMMAP={};NORMALIZE.forEach(([f,t])=>NORMMAP[f.toLowerCase()]=t);
const TPL_SRC={"DS-T-MDL501": "", "DS-T-HOME": "", "DS-T-AUTOPLOT": "", "DS-T-RESONANCE": "", "DS-T-USMACRO": "", "DS-T-YIELD": "", "DS-T-UNIV": "", "DS-T-INJECT": ""};
const TEMPLATES=[
 {id:'DS-T-MDL501',name:'VDF Data Module Controller v2.0',role:'VDF 資料模組控制器 · Full Ecosystem',font:'DM Mono',status:'ok',dev:[]},
 {id:'DS-T-HOME',name:'VIA Home Launcher',role:'首頁啟動器 · 模組總入口',font:'Syne',status:'adj',dev:['#4c72b0','#4f8a5b','#7a6cae','#64b5cd','#23405f']},
 {id:'DS-T-AUTOPLOT',name:'VeritasAutoPlot Console',role:'自動繪圖主控台 · 供各模板圖形',font:'Syne',status:'adj',dev:['#4c72b0','#c0392b','#2e7d52','#c8902f','#7a6cae']},
 {id:'DS-T-RESONANCE',name:'TW Resonance Stock Stack v3',role:'台股共振堆疊圖 · Equity Insight',font:'Syne',status:'ok',dev:[]},
 {id:'DS-T-USMACRO',name:'US Macro Template v3',role:'美國總經模板',font:'DM Mono',status:'adj',dev:['#1e3a5f']},
 {id:'DS-T-YIELD',name:'Yield-Curve Spread',role:'殖利率曲線利差',font:'DM Mono',status:'ok',dev:[]},
 {id:'DS-T-UNIV',py:1,name:'TW Universe Builder',role:'全台股宇宙建構 · TWSE+TPEx 免費官方源',font:'Python',status:'py',dev:[]},
 {id:'DS-T-INJECT',py:1,name:'VIA Inject',role:'資料注入器 → equity_real / etf_real → 注入 HTML',font:'Python',status:'py',dev:[]}
];
function dot(hex){return `<i style="background:${hex}"></i>`;}
function swPill(label,hex){return `<span class="sw">${dot(hex)}${esc(label)} ${hex}</span>`;}
function lockRootCss(){
 const all=[...LOCK_BASE,['--bl','#4c78a8'],['--bl-l','#d0e1f0'],['--tl','#439a9a'],['--tl-l','#c8e6e6'],['--gn','#5a9e6f'],['--gn-l','#cde8d5'],['--am','#c4943a'],['--am-l','#f5e2b8'],['--co','#c96b5a'],['--co-l','#f5d0c8'],['--vi','#7a6daa'],['--vi-l','#dcd8f0'],['--ro','#b05580'],['--bl-d','#3d6188'],...LOCK_INK];
 return ':root{'+all.map(([k,v])=>k+':'+v).join(';')+";--mo:'DM Mono';--sa:'DM Sans';--hf:'Syne'}";
}
function buildTpl(){
 const tbadge={ok:'<span class="tbadge ok">✓ 視覺已符合</span>',adj:'<span class="tbadge adj">⚠ 配色略調</span>',py:'<span class="tbadge py">Python 工具</span>'};
 const cards=TEMPLATES.map(t=>{
   const devs=t.dev.map(h=>{const to=NORMMAP[h.toLowerCase()]||h;return `<span class="pair">${dot(h)}${h}<span style="color:var(--i4)">→</span>${dot(to)}${to}</span>`;}).join('');
   const ed=tplEdited(t.id);
   const acts=`<div class="tdev" style="margin-top:8px;gap:5px">${t.py?'':`<button class="bn sm" onclick="tplPreview('${t.id}')">👁 預覽</button>`}<button class="bn sm" onclick="tplOpen('${t.id}')">↗ 開新分頁</button><button class="bn sm" onclick="tplEditToggle('${t.id}')">✏ 編輯</button><button class="bn sm" onclick="tplDownload('${t.id}')">⬇ 下載</button>${ed?'<span class="tbadge adj">已編輯</span>':''}</div><div id="tplbox-${t.id}"></div>`;
   return `<div class="tplc ${t.py?'py':''}" id="tplc-${t.id}"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px"><span class="tn">${esc(t.name)}</span>${tbadge[t.status]}</div>
     <div class="tr">${esc(t.role)} · 字型 ${esc(t.font)} · <span style="font-family:var(--mo);color:var(--i3)">${esc(t.id)}</span></div>
     ${devs?`<div class="tdev"><span style="font-size:8px;color:var(--i3)">略調對映:</span>${devs}</div>`:''}${acts}</div>`;
 }).join('');
 document.getElementById('tplMount').innerHTML=
  `<div class="lab-grp">① 視覺鎖定 · 統一色票(三主色 + 中性 + 強調)</div>
   <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--i2);margin-bottom:4px">三主色:</div><div class="swgrid">${LOCK_BRAND.map(([l,h])=>swPill(l,h)).join('')}</div>
   <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--i2);margin:4px 0">中性 / 表面:</div><div class="swgrid">${LOCK_BASE.map(([l,h])=>swPill(l,h)).join('')}</div>
   <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--i2);margin:4px 0">強調:</div><div class="swgrid">${LOCK_ACCENT.map(([l,h])=>swPill(l,h)).join('')}</div>
   <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--i2);margin:4px 0">文字墨階:</div><div class="swgrid">${LOCK_INK.map(([l,h])=>swPill(l,h)).join('')}</div>
   <button class="bn sm" style="margin-top:5px" onclick="copyText(lockRootCss())">📋 複製統一 :root</button>
   <div class="lab-grp">② 圖表系列正規化對映(一些配色可略調整 → 鎖定色)</div>
   ${NORMALIZE.map(([f,t,tk,ds])=>`<div class="normrow"><i style="background:${f}"></i><span class="hx">${f}</span><span class="ar">→</span><i style="background:${t}"></i><span class="hx">${t}</span><span class="tk">${tk}</span><span class="ds">${esc(ds)}</span></div>`).join('')}
   <button class="bn sm" style="margin-top:6px" onclick="copyText('const NORMALIZE='+JSON.stringify(NORMALIZE)+';')">📋 複製對映表 (JS)</button>
   <div class="lab-grp">③ 中性變數別名統一(HomeLauncher / AutoPlot)</div>
   <div class="swgrid">${VARALIAS.map(([a,b])=>`<span class="sw" style="border-radius:8px">${esc(a)} <span style="color:var(--i4)">→</span> <span style="color:var(--bl)">${esc(b)}</span></span>`).join('')}</div>
   <div class="lab-grp">④ 資料管線(Universe → VDF → DICT → Bridge → Inject → 模板)</div>
   <div class="pipe">
     <span class="pb src">TW Universe Builder<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--i3);font-size:8px">TWSE+TPEx 免費官方</span></span><span class="pa">▶</span>
     <span class="pb">VDF 引擎<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--i3);font-size:8px">日線/法人/財報</span></span><span class="pa">▶</span>
     <span class="pb">DICT</span><span class="pa">▶</span>
     <span class="pb hl">VIA_VDF_Bridge<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--i3);font-size:8px">分類/對應</span></span><span class="pa">▶</span>
     <span class="pb hl">VIA_Inject<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--i3);font-size:8px">equity_real / etf_real</span></span><span class="pa">▶</span>
     <span class="pb out">Equity Insight (Resonance)</span><span class="pb out">ETF Console</span>
   </div>
   <div style="font-size:8.5px;color:var(--i3);margin-top:3px">AutoPlot / Yield-Curve / US Macro / Home Launcher 由各引擎與 AutoPlot 供圖,共用同一鎖定色票。</div>
   <div class="lab-grp">⑤ 模板列管(${TEMPLATES.length})· 視覺鎖定狀態</div>
   ${cards}`;
}

/* ---- v1.9 template vault: open / preview / edit / apply visual-lock / download ---- */
const TPL_FILES={'DS-T-MDL501':'VDF_MDL501_DataModuleController.html','DS-T-HOME':'VIA_HomeLauncher.html','DS-T-AUTOPLOT':'VIA_AutoPlot_Console.html','DS-T-RESONANCE':'VIA_TW_Resonance_Stock_Stack.html','DS-T-USMACRO':'VIA_US_Macro_Template.html','DS-T-YIELD':'VIA_Yield_Curve_Spread.html','DS-T-UNIV':'VIA_TW_Universe_Builder.py','DS-T-INJECT':'VIA_Inject.py'};
function tplIsPy(id){return (TPL_FILES[id]||'').endsWith('.py');}
function b64utf8(b64){const bin=atob(b64);const a=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)a[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(a);}
function tplEdited(id){try{return localStorage.getItem('ds_tpl_edit:'+id)!=null;}catch(e){return false;}}
function tplHtml(id){try{const e=localStorage.getItem('ds_tpl_edit:'+id);if(e!=null)return e;}catch(e){}return (typeof TPL_SRC!=='undefined'&&TPL_SRC[id])?b64utf8(TPL_SRC[id]):'<!-- 原始碼未內嵌 -->';}
function tplBlobUrl(id){return URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([tplHtml(id)],{type:tplIsPy(id)?'text/plain;charset=utf-8':'text/html;charset=utf-8'}));}
function tplOpen(id){window.open(tplBlobUrl(id),'_blank');toast('已於新分頁開啟');}
function tplDownload(id){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=tplBlobUrl(id);a.download=TPL_FILES[id]||(id+'.html');a.click();toast('已下載 '+(TPL_FILES[id]||id));}
function tplPreview(id){const box=document.getElementById('tplbox-'+id);if(!box)return;if(box.dataset.mode==='pv'){box.innerHTML='';box.dataset.mode='';return;}box.dataset.mode='pv';box.innerHTML='<iframe class="tplframe"></iframe>';box.querySelector('iframe').srcdoc=tplHtml(id);}
function tplEditToggle(id){const box=document.getElementById('tplbox-'+id);if(!box)return;if(box.dataset.mode==='ed'){box.innerHTML='';box.dataset.mode='';return;}box.dataset.mode='ed';
 box.innerHTML=`<div style="margin-top:7px"><textarea id="tpled-${id}" class="tplta" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
   <div style="display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:5px">
     <button class="bn sm" onclick="tplApplyLock('${id}')">🔒 套用視覺鎖定</button>
     ${tplIsPy(id)?'':`<button class="bn sm" onclick="tplPreviewEdit('${id}')">👁 預覽編輯</button>`}
     <button class="bn sm" onclick="tplSaveEdit('${id}')">💾 存檔(本機)</button>
     <button class="bn sm" onclick="tplResetEdit('${id}')">↻ 還原原始</button>
     <button class="bn sm" onclick="tplDownloadEdit('${id}')">⬇ 下載編輯版</button>
   </div><div id="tplpv-${id}"></div></div>`;
 box.querySelector('textarea').value=tplHtml(id);
}
function tplApplyLock(id){const ta=document.getElementById('tpled-'+id);if(!ta)return;let h=ta.value;
 NORMALIZE.forEach(([f,t])=>{h=h.split(f).join(t);h=h.split(f.toUpperCase()).join(t);});
 VARALIAS.forEach(([a,b])=>{h=h.split(a+':').join(b+':');h=h.split('var('+a+')').join('var('+b+')');});
 ta.value=h;toast('已套用視覺鎖定(配色正規化)');}
function tplPreviewEdit(id){const pv=document.getElementById('tplpv-'+id);if(!pv)return;pv.innerHTML='<iframe class="tplframe"></iframe>';pv.querySelector('iframe').srcdoc=document.getElementById('tpled-'+id).value;}
function tplSaveEdit(id){try{localStorage.setItem('ds_tpl_edit:'+id,document.getElementById('tpled-'+id).value);toast('已存檔(本機)');const c=document.getElementById('tplc-'+id);}catch(e){toast('存檔失敗(localStorage 容量上限)');}buildTpl();}
function tplResetEdit(id){try{localStorage.removeItem('ds_tpl_edit:'+id);}catch(e){}toast('已還原原始');buildTpl();}
function tplDownloadEdit(id){const ta=document.getElementById('tpled-'+id);const v=ta?ta.value:tplHtml(id);const blob=new Blob([v],{type:tplIsPy(id)?'text/plain;charset=utf-8':'text/html;charset=utf-8'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=(TPL_FILES[id]||id+'.html').replace(/(\.[^.]+)$/,'_locked$1');a.click();toast('已下載編輯版');}

/* ---- init ---- */
try{if(localStorage.getItem('ds_theme')==='dark'){document.body.classList.add('dark');document.getElementById('themeBtn').textContent='☀ Light';}}catch(e){}
buildStats();buildSysFilter();buildFilters();render();buildReader();
</script>
